::: {#def-equivalence .theorem}
## Equivalence

Two random variables are equivalent if they belong to different observational units but represent the same construct:

$$
X_i\sim X_j\iff X_i\in\mathscr{O}_i,\ X_j\in\mathscr{O}_j,\ X_i\text{ and }X_j\text{ represent the same construct},\ i\neq j.
$$

A unit carries at most one variable of each construct. Extended to hold between a variable and itself, $\sim$ is an equivalence relation.
:::
